scag:feature:half-elf-moon-sun-cantrip.name: 戲法
scag:feature:half-elf-moon-sun-cantrip.data.desc.0: 你學會一個自選的法師戲法；智力是你施展該戲法的施法屬性。

scag:feature:half-elf-elf-weapon-trainin.name: 精靈武器訓練
scag:feature:half-elf-elf-weapon-trainin.data.desc.0: 你熟練長劍、短劍、短弓與長弓。

scag:feature:half-elf-fleet-of-foot.name: 輕捷步伐
scag:feature:half-elf-fleet-of-foot.data.desc.0: 你的基礎步行速度提升為 35 尺。

scag:feature:half-elf-mask-of-the-wild.name: 荒野隱蔽
scag:feature:half-elf-mask-of-the-wild.data.desc.0: 即使只受到樹葉、大雨、降雪、薄霧或其他自然現象造成的輕度遮蔽，你也可以嘗試躲藏。

scag:feature:half-elf-swimming-speed.name: 游泳
scag:feature:half-elf-swimming-speed.data.desc.0: 你獲得 30 尺游泳速度。

scag:feature:half-elf-drow-magic.name: 卓爾魔法
scag:feature:half-elf-drow-magic.data.desc.0: 你學會舞光術；角色 3 級時可每次長休施展一次妖火術，5 級時可每次長休施展一次黑暗術；魅力是你的施法屬性。
